pattern: ようと思う（ようとおもう）
purpose: Express an intention using a quoted volitional form.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Volitional form + と思う / と思っている.
I think I will go to the library this weekend.
I am thinking of taking a Japanese test next year.
I think I will go home early today.
formation: Volitional form + と思う / と思っている.
restrictions: 思っている often presents an intention held over time.
mistake: The action is intended, rather than necessarily already arranged.
